svg.text: As-Is: corporate onboarding and periodic KYC review
Illustrative redesign for a CIB branch in Hong Kong. Built from public material; simulated, not real bank data.
Generic checklist by email: the client can't tell what applies to them
Packs arrive incomplete, so the client is chased in several rounds
The same data is typed into several systems by hand
Ownership is traced through registries country by country
Most screening hits are false positives, each cleared by hand
Defects surface at the end, sending the file back
Each review restarts from scratch, even when nothing changed
First request: is it clear what the bank needs from us?
Asked again: does the bank remember what we already sent?
Accounts live: how long did it take to start doing business?
